parts:
Hi,

Thanks in advance.

I am using R-3.0.1 on Windows XP.

I am trying to plot bar chart (top half) and a data set (bottom half) on a single page.

Is there anyway I can do it using ggplot2 please?

Can I scroll through the data if it is large in size?

The code below I have borrowed from Hadley's hadout_ggplo2.pdf.

As an example, I am trying to put the data set mtcars at the bottom of the graph.

Once again, thank you very much for the time you have given.

Regards,

Deb

Code: 

qplot(factor(cyl), data=mtcars, geom="bar", fill=factor(cyl))
